correctness.rationale: The frozen census is mathematically sound, but its r=1 branch has exact same-day coverage. The repaired RESULT limits the theorem to r≥2 and cites the r=1 counts as background. In the repair, the forward-gap composition with a marked occupied site proves the indexed count, including the singleton and empty cases. The equality of readouts is equivalent to a two-periodic XOR difference. A whole-site complement collision forces sitewise alternation, ruled out on odd rings and at separation r≥2. A parity complement forces the other parity to be zero, then excludes both 00 and 11 on the flipped parity sublattice. That gives exactly the complementary residue classes of spacing four when 4 divides n, and requires r=2 or 3. The even and odd pairs yield different alternating outputs because exactly one neighbor is occupied at each opposite-parity site. These exhaust all masks, so no fiber can exceed two in the repaired scope and the exact indexed image and singleton counts follow. The finite checker was inspected, not executed; the exact proof is the replay path, and the claimed finite-run evidence is corroborative only.
